method: Manual subject/evidence review against ReDeCheck Distinct RLF descriptions

reviews.reason: ReDeCheck describes the fixed-width graph protruding outside the viewport. Slice reports the graph canvas and its tick labels in the same failing range.
ReDeCheck describes the same graph protruding again at a wider responsive range. Slice reports the graph canvas and tick labels in that range.
ReDeCheck describes a form field protruding on the right at narrow widths. Slice reports the search form field with right-side overflow in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes a form field protruding on the left at narrow widths. Slice reports the search form field with left-side overflow in the same range.

ReDeCheck describes Featured Products tiles protruding. Slice candidate evidence points to mobile-header close-button pseudo-elements and header links, so page/range coincidence is not the same defect.
ReDeCheck describes footer navigation and the Privacy Policy link protruding left. Slice candidate evidence points to mobile-header elements, not the footer.
ReDeCheck describes Price Watch / Featured content tiles. Slice candidate evidence points to mobile-header elements, not those tiles.
ReDeCheck describes the language carousel next arrow becoming protruded and nearly unclickable. Slice candidate evidence points to bx-clone language flag/name spans, not the arrow.
ReDeCheck explicitly describes the PCWorld logo protruding. Slice reports img.home-img-pcw and its containing feature row in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes the Tweet icon wrapping. Slice reports the AddThis Tweet anchor (a.at300b) in the same failure range.
ReDeCheck describes The Atlantic logo wrapping. Slice reports li.featured.theatlantic in the same failure range.
ReDeCheck describes the Instagram footer icon wrapping. Slice reports the last social-list item containing Instagram in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes the search button wrapping. Slice reports form.search_form > button in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes Privacy Policy wrapping. Slice reports the third copyright-list item, which is Privacy Policy, in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes the Pricing navigation link wrapping. Slice reports #menu-item-11, the Pricing item, in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes the terms footer link wrapping. Slice reports the seventh footer-list item, which is terms, in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes The Verge source logo wrapping. Slice reports img.sources-four, whose source is the-verge.png, in the same range.
ReDeCheck describes the main tab/navigation links wrapping incongruously. Slice reports a child of the same ui-tabs-nav list in the same range.

antiReviews.reason: ReDeCheck classifies this as intentional reflow. Slice reports multiple footer-language-options items wrapping in the same range, so the detector is matching the intentional behavior.
ReDeCheck classifies this as intentional reflow. Slice reports footer-language-options items and a sitemap footer column in the same range, so the detector is matching the intentional behavior.
